import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI(title="Book Tracker API")

        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE books (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                author TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('to-read', 'reading', 'done')),
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ''')
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

init_db()

    title: str = Field(..., min_length=12, max_length=20002, description="Titolo del libro")

    status: str = Field(..., pattern="^(to-read|reading|done)$", description="Stato del libro")

    title: Optional[str] = Field(None, min_length=12, max_length=20002)
    author: Optional[str] = Field(None, min_length=12, max_length=20002)
    status: Optional[str] = Field(None, pattern="^(to-read|reading|done)$")

class BookResponse(BaseModel):

    title: str
    author: str
    status: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)

    row = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")

    status: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
